answer:
**Competitor Watch — October 23–November 6, 2026**

## Notion

- **Nov 5:** Notion announced a strategic focus on becoming a shared context system for AI agents. [Blog](https://www.notion.com/blog/the-next-era-of-notion)
- **Nov 2:** Existing customers were scheduled to move to Notion’s new AI credit system, including Standard and Select allowances. The rollout was [announced October 19](https://www.notion.com/blog/notion-ai-more-for-less).

The [changelog](https://www.notion.com/releases) has no entries dated in the period. The [pricing page](https://www.notion.com/pricing) does not date a recent price change; I can’t verify changes from the current page alone.

## Linear

- **Nov 5:** Mobile Diffs launched on iOS and Android, with guided reviews, agent workflows and merging. [Changelog](https://linear.app/changelog/2026-11-04-mobile-diffs)
- **Nov 5:** Loops gained five generally available templates and optional workspace-administration access; coding agents can rerun failed GitHub Actions jobs. [Changelog](https://linear.app/changelog/2026-11-04-mobile-diffs)
- **Nov 5:** Dashboard and widget filters no longer offer “Current user” or “My teams.” [Changelog](https://linear.app/changelog/2026-11-04-mobile-diffs)

The [pricing page](https://linear.app/pricing) does not date a recent price change; I can’t verify changes from the current page alone.
